name: SCRUM-9 - Search and Reset System Users
objective: Search System Users by username, role, employee name, status, and combined criteria, then reset filters.
precondition: The administrator is logged in and the System Users list contains records.

steps.description: Search by username, role, employee name, and status.
steps.expectedResult: Only records matching each selected criterion are displayed.

steps.description: Apply combined username and role criteria.
steps.expectedResult: Only records satisfying all applied criteria are displayed.
All filters are cleared and the default user list and count are restored.
